items.ti: 우리 아름다운 반사 연못의 수치스러운 파괴 행위와 관련하여 많은 추가 사람들이 체포되었습니다. 1922년 처음 지어진 이래로 이런 모습도, 작동한 적도 없는데, 그때도 심하게 누수되어 작동하지 않았습니다. 우리 제품은 거울과 같은 마감을 포함하여 완벽하게 작동했으며 이전에는 없었던 두 개의 위대한 기념물을 완벽하게 반영했습니다! 이 끔찍한 파괴자들이 저지른 일은 조지 워싱턴 대통령과 에이브러햄 링컨 대통령 모두에 대한 진정한 모욕이며 그에 따라 처리되어야 합니다. 오늘 우리는 계약자들을 만났는데 아마도 필요한 수리를 하기 위해 많은 양의 물을 방류하고 배수해야 할 것이지만 가능한 한 빨리 완료하도록 할 것입니다. 그들이 피해를 입힌 것에는 이전에 가장 적은 양의 풀을 죽인 것도 포함되지 않습니다. 그들은 어떤 형태의 칼이나 칼날을 가져다가 250피트 길이의
items.ti_en: Many additional people have been arrested having to do with the disgraceful Vandalism of our beautiful Reflecting Pool. It hasn’t looked or worked like this since 1922, when it was originally built, but even then, it leaked badly, and didn’t work. Ours worked perfectly, including the mirror like finish, perfectly reflecting the two Great Monuments, which it never had before! What these terrible Vandals have done is a true affront to both Presidents George Washington and Abraham Lincoln, and should be dealt with accordingly. We met with contractors today, will probably be forced to release and drain much of the water in order to do the necessary repairs, but will have them done as quickly as possible. What they have damaged does not even include the earlier killing of a large amount of grass which was, by far, the least of it. They took some form of knife or blade, and put a 250 foot long gash into the beautiful facade of what took so much work, competence, and money to build and complete. They also poured corrosive and destructive chemicals into the Pool. The Reflecting Pool was never so beautiful as it was just one week ago, even going back to 1922 when it opened. We are very proud of what we have done with this magnificent structure, and we will get it repaired, quickly, to an equal level of Beauty. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
